messages:
tess.mkt: Quick sync idea 
Want a small PLG launch experiment tied to the webinar + social posts. Primary goal: increase first-10-min activation by 10% and improve TOFU->first_prompt conversion. Mix: modest credits, compact prompt packs, and smarter inbound routing. Thoughts?

nate.growth: yes. propose 3-arm test: control (status quo), credits-only ($15), credits + micro-templates + guided CTA. keep cell sizes ~600 each.

zoe.content: friendly post copy concepts:
- Post A: "Ship your first LLM feature in 10 min 
Claim $15 + starter prompts."
- Post B: "See our micro-benchmark: similar latency, ~25% token savings. Try with $15."
I'll make 1 hero image + 1 screenshot for each.

vik.ops: routing: recommend tagging webinar leads with lead_type=ignite_seed, then webhook to routing lambda to apply credit grant. Pseudocode: 
````
POST /webhook -> payload
if (payload.source == 'webinar' && payload.campaign == 'ignite-spark') {
  crm.assignTag(user, 'ignite_seed');
  grants.queueCredit(user.id, 15);
}
````

evelyn.rs: on the eval side we'll run a tiny benchmark set (3 prompts): write bug report, expand bullet list to tasks, polish sales blurb. We'll log tokens, latency, and a simple ROUGE-like overlap score vs baseline.

nate.growth: nudges for arm 3: in-app toast immediately after signup -> "Try this one template: turn meeting notes into tasks" with one-click run. Email Day2: "3 quick templates you can try". Day4: office hours invite. Keep it lightweight.

vik.ops: infra guardrails: soft daily token cap 40k per org for seed cohort. add alert at 70% utilization. Also rate-limit the grant webhook to 5 req/s.

zoe.content: landing microcopy: concise hero, checklist: 1) claim $15, 2) run 'meeting->tasks' demo, 3) check benchmark. CTA button: "Try starter pack".

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: "ignite-spark: launch experiment go-live" on 2025-07-02 14:00 UTC.

tess.mkt: owners: creative=zoe, routing=vik, growth=nate, evals=evelyn. Timeline: creative by Fri, routing + infra by Mon, go-live Wed, 7-day run.

evelyn.rs: logging: tag interactions with experiment_id and cohort. We'll export a small CSV with per-user avg_tokens, success_flag, and first_prompt_time.

nate.growth: measurement plan: primary = first_prompt_rate within 24h, secondary = 7-day active. use Amplitude + short SQL check. I'll also run a holdout check to ensure traffic parity.

vik.ops: I'll add the routing lambda and deploy a canary. grant queue will be idemp (only one grant per user).

zoe.content: sharing mockups in #marketing-drafts tonight. planning two short hero gifs (6s) that show "claim -> run -> win" flow.

tess.mkt: perfect. final checklist before launch: mockups in channel, lambda deployed, experiment flags live, amplitude events instrumented, eval harness running. ping this thread when done. :rocket:

nate.growth: one more ask 
Can we include small benchmark blurb in the registration flow? "Quick benchmark: x tokens per task" helps set expectations.

evelyn.rs: ok i'll provide the sample numbers once harness warms up (expect a rough median tokens number).

vik.ops: all set on infra tasks; will post PR link once merged.

deploy-bot: Note: experiment flag created: exp_ignite_spark_2025_07.

tess.mkt: thanks team 
closing loop once we see the PRs and mocks.
